subject: Immediate action: LedgerOne production throttle + reserved throughput shortfall
messages:
From: Jason Li <jason.li@ledgerone.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: LedgerOne SRE <sre@ledgerone.com>, Procurement <procurement@ledgerone.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden 5xx + latency spike on production (region: us-west)

Mina,

We started seeing significant tail latency and intermittent 5xx errors at ~08:45 PDT for our production workload riding the reserved pool. P95 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.3s and we observed a sustained token backlog — several hundred queued requests. The client library shows requests are hitting the reserved endpoint and the usage graph indicates throughput flatlined just under our committed QPS.

Attached is a short log excerpt and a graph capture from our monitoring. This is impacting checkout flows and a small subset of users are seeing failures. Can you confirm what's happening on the Redwood side and whether there is immediate remediation you can apply?

We need an expedited timeline — if this is capacity-related we need temporary burst or credits while we discuss a longer-term solution.

— Jason
Jason Li
Head of Platform Engineering, LedgerOne
(jason.li@ledgerone.com)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Li <jason.li@ledgerone.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 5xx + latency spike on production (region: us-west)

Jason — thanks for the quick heads up and the attachments. We're looking into it now. Initial read: the request stream shows a pattern consistent with a rapid headroom consumption on the dedicated GPU pool serving LedgerOne's reserved capacity. I'm bringing ops and capacity on the thread and will confirm diagnostics within 20–30 minutes.

For transparency, can you confirm whether there were any heavy batch jobs or model config changes from your side in the last hour? That helps rule out client-side burst patterns.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sudden 5xx + latency spike on production (region: us-west)

Team — ops update: infra telemetry shows the LedgerOne dedicated pool hit a sustained utilization floor across multiple GPU nodes at 08:40 PDT. Autoscaling attempted to add nodes but several pending allocations failed due to transient CUDA driver timeouts on the host fabric (root cause being investigated). Result = effective throughput shortfall relative to their reservation and rising queue depth.

Immediate actions proposed:
- Force-burst: temporarily allocate 2x burst nodes from Shared-Burst capacity for 2 hours (requires exec sign-off for cross-customer burst).
- Traffic shaping: apply per-route QPS cap to their non-critical routes to protect checkout traffic for 30m.
- Offer a one-time goodwill credit equal to one week's committed spend if we can't restore headroom within 2 hours.

I can start the force-burst request and open the driver debug tickets. Need decision from Revenue/Exec for cross-customer burst and credits.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sudden 5xx + latency spike on production (region: us-west)

Aditya / Mina — pinging you both because the ask has commercial implications. Short summary: LedgerOne's reserved pool is under-provisioned at the moment due to host-level driver faults; we can mitigate with Shared-Burst nodes but that means temporary margin bleed and a one-time manual approval for cross-tenant allocation. If we don't act quickly, queueing will grow and error rates will cascade.

Suggested commercial offer (to propose to execs):
1) Immediate: Approve force-burst (2 nodes) + traffic shaping now — ops has the playbook.
2) Credit: Offer a $7.5k goodwill credit or equivalent service credit while we complete RCA.
3) Follow-up: Commit to a technical remediation plan (driver patch + staged node replacement) and a checkpoint call with LedgerOne in 48 hours.

Aditya — please advise if this credit and burst can be approved by you or whether we need a higher-level sign-off.

— Vivek
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Jason Li <jason.li@ledgerone.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@ledgerone.com>, LedgerOne SRE <sre@ledgerone.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden 5xx + latency spike on production (region: us-west)

Thanks for the quick mobilization. We have no scheduled batch jobs and didn't change model parameters. The errors are concentrated on the realtime checkout route. If Redwood can provide immediate burst capacity and a temporary QPS cap on non-checkout routes, that would keep our peak users safe while we coordinate.

LedgerOne is prepared to expedite renewal paperwork for an expanded reservation if we get a plan and a brief credit as a bridge — happy to involve procurement if you confirm the commercial path. We appreciate the transparent options list.

— Jason
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Jason Li <jason.li@ledgerone.com>
Cc: Finance <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Resolution path: temporary burst approved + commercial bridge

Quick update and decisions:
- Force-burst: Approved for 120 minutes starting Wed 16 May 2028 17:50 PDT — ops will attach 2 Shared-Burst nodes to LedgerOne's reservation and monitor headroom.
- Traffic shaping: Ops will apply route-level caps (non-checkout) immediately; we'll prioritize checkout traffic.
- Credit: Approving a one-time service credit equivalent to $7,500 to be applied to the next invoice as a commercial bridge while we complete RCA. Finance, please flag any contraints.

Next steps:
1) Ops runbook: Grace will share the driver debug ticket and node replacement ETA by EOD.
2) Customer check-in: Mina to schedule a 30-minute checkpoint with LedgerOne tomorrow to review mitigation and next steps for reservation sizing.
3) Follow-up RCA: Engineering will provide a technical RCA and remediation plan within 72 hours.

Jason — sorry for the impact. We're on it and will keep you updated in the shared drive folder (link below).

Attachments: proposed-credit-and-burst.docx (summary of offer)

— Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
